text.p: These are the leading stories in the Egyptian press on Thursday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.

- Prime Minister Kamal Ganzouri starts a visit to China today to discuss setting up joint projects and increasing bilateral trade. The 15 projects include a joint trading company as well as a huge cement project.
During the delegation's visit to Singapore, they discussed setting up a container port and an industrial centre.
- Singapore and Egypt sign agreement to protect and encourage joint investments.
